notes.title: 100% reproductible traffic update!🥳
notes.notes:
🥳Big update for #ClassicSportDriving!🥳

Initially, traffic (random) could be frustrating / unfair when you wanted to time attack.

Now everyone gets the very same traffic on every run!
No more random, it's your driving skills only!💪

notes.title: Major campaign update!🥳
notes.notes:
A long awaited update for Classic Sport Driving is now live!🥳

The solo campaign is... not solo anymore!😱
You can now see how you fare against others through the whole campaign!🥳


Extending on our weekly and monthly events, this updated campaign, 16 races longs, takes the competition one step further in Classic Sport Driving!

Thanks to the many players, this is now the best place to get close competition, whatever your level is!🏆
And to chase the ultimate record!💪
Tell us about it! (also on X, where we discuss the results!)👋

Also, the campaign now offers a smoother progression, starting (relatively😅) easy and step by step increasing the difficulty.
Which makes it a great training ground to prepare for the seasonal events!💪

Join the competition now!🏆

notes.title: Major Classic Sport Driving update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37734254/c6fd252e19f2a008b8033ceba0530f13f98390d0.pngHey, we have a big update for Classic Sport Driving ready!

🔹New challenges available!

Say hi to the weekly (Monday - Friday) and weekend official challenges!😀
They're here for even more competition, with more time to learn the tracks than the daily races!
(the daily races will come back later!)

🔹Shorter and more intense races!

Our last poll on Twitter said that you wanted the official races to be slightly shorter. That's ready!😀
The solo campaign is not affected, and retains its full 1h30 length (that is, if you're a champion!😉).

🔹New season!

The track generator switched to a new season, with also shorter and more intense races.
The races are still longer than the weekly/weekend challenges, but the new format should make learning the track easier.😀
Each track code now leads to a completely different track! Check what your favorite codes have become!🤪
(you can still access the previous season by adding .b7 at then end of the track code!)


We hope you'll like this new version!
Let's see who will win the very first weekend and weekly challenges!👀

Sylvain, Jill, Philipp, Koscape, Laurent, Andrew🕹️

notes.title: Daily races and Ai update!🏎️===💨
notes.notes:
Hey, we have a new update ready!👋


🚘Starting Saturday, we will test a shorter format for the daily races!
(based on a suggestion from elocnat)

While track-generated tracks stay available forever, you only have a limited time to learn the layout of a daily race.
This shorter format will help learning the curves, and we hope that this will allow for even more competition!💪
Tell us how you feel about it on Saturday!😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37734254/53ff4dc9d2ea68116070d0ea78aa87ce062fd8ba.png

🚘AI opponents update!

You can now push sideways an AI car (except when they're already on the side of the road)!
This will make them less prone to impede with your racing time!
Their ability to avoid contact has been further improved.
And you'll get a bit less AI cars on the road overall.

All together, this will (again) mean less random, and more space for skill!🏆

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37734254/7440207127a75d49d1604ca72c44573dea683eee.png

notes.title: AI opponents update! 🚗🚗🏎️
notes.notes:
We've just updated the AI opponents behavior, so that they have a lesser impact on your races!

They now:

Change lines slower, which makes them more predictable.
Do not change lines in sharp curves.
Do a better job when things gets too close and they try to avoid you!😱


As a consequence, the random part now plays a smaller role, and your racing lines skills a bigger role!🏆

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37734254/83f39874c1e5fef4e1f0c049751997c8573fa767.png
Show us what you're capable of in the daily races!👋
